from sqlalchemy.orm import Session


def get_posts_with_authors(db: Session) -> list[dict]:
    posts = db.query(Post).all()
    result = []
    for post in posts:
        author = db.query(User).filter(User.id == post.author_id).first()
        result.append({'title': post.title, 'author': author.name})
    return result

import requests


async def fetch_prices(product_ids: list[int]) -> list[float]:
    prices = []
    for pid in product_ids:
        resp = requests.get(f'https://pricing.example.com/price/{pid}')
        prices.append(resp.json()['price'])
    return prices

import re


def validate_emails(emails: list[str]) -> list[bool]:
    results = []
    for email in emails:
        match = re.match(r'[a-zA-Z0-9._%+-]+@[a-zA-Z0-9.-]+', email)
        results.append(bool(match))
    return results

import asyncio
import time


async def wait_for_completion(job_id: str, max_retries: int = 10) -> dict:
    for attempt in range(max_retries):
        result = await check_job_status(job_id)
        if result['done']:
            return result
        time.sleep(2)
    raise TimeoutError(f'Job {job_id} timed out')

import psycopg2

DSN = 'postgresql://app:pass@localhost/mydb'


def bulk_insert_events(events: list[dict]) -> None:
    for event in events:
        conn = psycopg2.connect(DSN)
        cur = conn.cursor()
        cur.execute(
            'INSERT INTO events (type, payload) VALUES (%s, %s)',
            (event['type'], event['payload']),
        )
        conn.commit()
        conn.close()

from fastapi import APIRouter
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session

router = APIRouter()


@router.get('/audit-logs')
async def list_audit_logs(db: Session) -> list[dict]:
    logs = db.query(AuditLog).order_by(AuditLog.created_at.desc()).all()
    return [{'id': str(l.id), 'message': l.message} for l in logs]
